tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: Screen background. Warm paper by day, charcoal by night. Never pure white or pure black.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, list groups and the fill of every slab. Sits on ground with shadow-card, no border; floating slabs (transport tray, tab bar, mini player, sheets, menus, dialogs) keep this fill but use shadow-float.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Segmented-control track, progress track, search field. Below the surface, so darker by day and darker by night too.

tokens.name: surface-key
tokens.usage: An unlit transport key inside the tray.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Row separators and the outline of secondary buttons. Hairline only.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headings, titles, primary text. The night ink is warm off-white, not pure white.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Artist lines, captions, times, eyebrow labels. 4.5:1 on ground and surface in both themes.

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Disabled text, drag handles, chevrons. Decorative only: below 4.5:1, never for text that must be read.

tokens.name: copper
tokens.usage: The thin copper rim around the phone bezel and the turntable deck. Web: only the rim on cover art and the placeholder disc (rim-copper). Decoration, never a text or button colour.

tokens.name: copper-deep
tokens.usage: iOS only (not used on the web). Shaded edge of the copper rim and the deck's inner border.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The single accent: the lit play/pause key, the active segment, the progress fill, the active tab icon. Cyan is a light; keep it on controls, not on text.

tokens.name: accent-ink
tokens.usage: Accent as TEXT: links, 'Queue (12)', the selected sort, tab labels. Teal by day (4.7:1 on ground), pale cyan by night (11:1).

tokens.name: accent-strong
tokens.usage: Filled chip ('All') and the primary button fill. White text on it by day (3.3:1 at 15px semibold, bump to 17px+ or use accent-ink text), ink text by night.

tokens.name: accent-tint
tokens.usage: Selected-row wash, active-tab pill, selected segment background.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and glyphs on an accent or accent-tint fill. Dark teal ink, never white.

tokens.name: ok
tokens.usage: 'Server online' LED dot and 'On iPhone' check. The dot may use the raw LED green #38e464; text uses this token.

tokens.name: power
tokens.usage: The tiny red LED on the deck, 'Delete from library', 'Server unavailable'. A signal, never a surface.

tokens.name: power-text
tokens.usage: power as TEXT: error and unavailable messages, destructive menu items. Darker by day (5.2:1 on surface, 4.8:1 on ground); equals power by night (5.3:1 on surface). Use power for LEDs and glyphs, power-text for words.

tokens.name: vinyl
tokens.usage: The record on the platter, in both themes.

tokens.name: chrome
tokens.usage: iOS only (not used on the web). Tonearm, spindle, the small volume knob. Flat metal, no gradient in UI code; the mockups' brushed look is for the deck only.

tokens.name: brand-youtube
tokens.usage: Service icon next to Get metadata once that service returned data; icons only, never text or surfaces; inactive state uses ink-faint.

tokens.name: brand-soundcloud
tokens.usage: Service icon next to Get metadata once that service returned data; icons only, never text or surfaces; inactive state uses ink-faint.

tokens.name: brand-spotify
tokens.usage: Service icon next to Get metadata once that service returned data; icons only, never text or surfaces; inactive state uses ink-faint.

tokens.name: brand-wikipedia
tokens.usage: Service icon next to Get metadata once that service returned data; icons only, never text or surfaces; inactive state uses ink-faint.

tokens.name: brand-musicbrainz
tokens.usage: Service icon next to Get metadata once that service returned data; icons only, never text or surfaces; inactive state uses ink-faint. MusicBrainz magenta (not the orange, which would read as SoundCloud): 4.1:1 on day ground, 3.5:1 on night ground, above the 3:1 icon minimum.

tokens.usage: Categorical series 0 (cyan): genre family colours on the Genres map and Song stats, graph marks only, never text. Pair with a label or position; never rely on hue alone.

tokens.usage: Categorical series 10 (brown): genre family colours on the Genres map and Song stats, graph marks only, never text. Pair with a label or position; never rely on hue alone.

tokens.name: chart-11
tokens.usage: Categorical series 11 (magenta): genre family colours on the Genres map and Song stats, graph marks only, never text. Pair with a label or position; never rely on hue alone.

tokens.name: chart-12
tokens.usage: Categorical series 12 (grey): same values as ink-muted, so the neutral family follows the ink ramp. Graph marks only.

tokens.name: chart-13
tokens.usage: Categorical series 13 (teal): genre family colours on the Genres map and Song stats, graph marks only, never text. Pair with a label or position; never rely on hue alone.

tokens.name: chart-14

tokens.name: chart-15
tokens.usage: Categorical series 15 (silver): the quiet neutral. Kept at its original value rather than ink-faint, which is 2.4:1 on surface by day and 2.5:1 by night, too low for a graph mark (3:1).

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Dim layer behind dialogs and sheets, and the title band over Ring and Terrain.

tokens.name: fill
tokens.usage: Day-safe accent for focus-adjacent fills: progress arcs, slider tracks and switch tracks. Accent-strong by day, accent by night.

tokens.name: on-fill
tokens.usage: Glyph or text colour on a fill surface (switch thumb mark, label over a progress fill). Ink by day, on-accent by night.

tokens.name: ring-color
tokens.usage: Focus ring colour (outline: var(--ring-width) solid var(--ring-color), :focus-visible only). A container may override it, e.g. the visualizer sets accent.

tokens.name: caret
tokens.usage: caret-color of text fields.

tokens.name: selection
tokens.usage: ::selection background.

color.note: Categorical palette for charts and graphs, 16 series, tuned per theme for at least 3:1 against surface. Not text colours.

families.sans: -apple-system, "SF Pro Display", "SF Pro Text", system-ui, "Helvetica Neue", sans-serif

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Screen title under the eyebrow: Library, Now playing, Settings (.largeTitle.bold).

styles.name: headline
styles.usage: Row titles, card headings ('Up next'), segment and button labels (.headline).

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Artist lines, settings values, search placeholder (.body), in ink-muted when secondary.

styles.name: subhead
styles.usage: Chips, status lines ('Playing from this iPhone'), tab labels at 500 (.subheadline).

styles.name: subhead-strong
styles.usage: Button labels, selected chips, mini-player title, desktop row title (.subheadline.semibold).

styles.name: micro
styles.usage: Chart legends, the download-ring label, tab labels on narrow phones. Smallest step; never for body text.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Small uppercase label, +2px tracking, in ink-muted. Web only: the Sidebar's wordmark subtitle and section labels. Never on iOS screens — the app name does not sit above a screen title.

styles.name: time
styles.usage: Elapsed / remaining time, durations in rows, the lock-screen clock scale. Monospaced so digits don't jitter.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap, LED-to-text gap.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Chip gap, key gap inside the transport tray.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Row inner padding, chip horizontal padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding, screen edge inset.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Dialog and sheet padding, gap between page sections on web.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Section gap on Playback (deck → title → progress → transport).

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Space above the first screen title.

tokens.name: hit
tokens.usage: Minimum tap target. Transport keys are 52 × 44, the lit key 56 × 48.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Innermost nesting: marks, thumbs, small tags. Rule: inner radius = outer radius minus the padding between them.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Cover thumbnails, search field inner.

tokens.name: radius-key
tokens.usage: Transport keys, the lit play key, settings cells.

tokens.name: radius-card
tokens.usage: Cards, the list group, the deck frame.

tokens.name: radius-tray
tokens.usage: The transport tray and the floating tab bar: a pill-ish slab, not a full pill.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Chips, the segmented control, the LED dot.

shadow.note: Quiet glass: one soft ambient shadow and a top highlight. Floating slabs get shadow-float (lift + line ring). No drop shadows on text, no glows except the lit key. The copper rim is the only coloured edge: rim-copper, on cover art and the placeholder disc.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Cards, list groups and other slabs that sit on ground. Not for anything floating over other cards: use shadow-float.

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: Floating slabs that sit over content: the transport tray, the tab bar, the mini player, sheets, menus and dialogs. A stronger lift than shadow-card plus a 1px line ring, so a slab never melts into a card of the same surface — by night especially. These slabs fill with surface (see surface); the ring is their rim, so they take no extra border.

tokens.name: shadow-key
tokens.usage: An unlit transport key: barely raised.

tokens.name: glow-accent
tokens.usage: The lit play/pause key only. By night the top highlight drops to the same 8% white as the other shadows.

tokens.name: rim-copper
tokens.usage: Hairline copper rim (copper at 35%) on cover art and the placeholder disc only. Web only. No generic rim token: shadow-float's ring is the rim of slabs.

tokens.name: stroke-hairline
tokens.usage: Outlines of secondary buttons, rims, separators. The only line weight for a rim; 1.5px is retired.

tokens.name: stroke-focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring thickness (see state ring).

tokens.name: stroke-progress
tokens.usage: Progress arcs and thin tracks (download ring, volume track).

state.note: Interaction states for the web. Hover and pressed mix ink into the control's own fill (color-mix); pressed also scales. Reapply the colour tokens inside a dark container so these re-resolve. Scrollbars: thumb in the line colour on a transparent track, thin (scrollbar-width); written directly in the web CSS, not a token.

tokens.name: hover-mix
tokens.usage: Share of ink mixed into a control's fill on :hover (pointer devices).

tokens.name: pressed-mix
tokens.usage: Share of ink mixed into a control's fill on :active.

tokens.name: pressed-scale
tokens.usage: transform: scale() on :active.

tokens.name: disabled-opacity
tokens.usage: Opacity of any disabled control; cursor stays default.

tokens.name: ring-width
tokens.usage: Focus ring thickness; equals stroke-focus.

tokens.name: ring-offset
tokens.usage: Gap between the control edge and its focus ring.

tokens.name: scrollbar-width
tokens.usage: scrollbar-width.

motion.note: Reduced motion: under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce set animation and transition durations to .01ms, never animation: none !important, so end states and events still fire. Keep static fallbacks for marquee and flash. Linear is reserved for progress arcs and spinners (1s).

tokens.name: dur-fast
tokens.usage: Hover, press, small toggles, thumb scale.

tokens.name: dur-base
tokens.usage: Menus, chips, panel changes, dialog fade.

tokens.name: dur-slow
tokens.usage: Sheet slide, layout moves.

tokens.name: ease-out
tokens.usage: Entrances and most transitions.

tokens.name: ease-io
tokens.usage: Moves that start and end on screen (position, size).

tokens.name: enter-offset
tokens.usage: Vertical rise of an element entering (toasts, menus, banners) before it settles at its place; paired with enter-scale and dur-base.

tokens.name: enter-scale
tokens.usage: Starting scale of an entering dialog or menu; transitions to 1 over dur-base.

elevation.note: Stacking order. Replaces the ad-hoc z-index values.

tokens.name: z-sticky
tokens.usage: Sticky headers and rails.

tokens.name: z-float
tokens.usage: Tray, tab bar, mini player.

tokens.name: z-menu
tokens.usage: Menus and popovers.

tokens.name: z-dialog
tokens.usage: Dialogs and sheets.

tokens.name: z-toast
tokens.usage: Toasts.

tokens.name: z-full
tokens.usage: Full-screen surfaces such as the visualizer.

overlay.note: Veils over imagery and content; the dialog scrim is the scrim colour token. The visualizer canvas colours (--viz-*) are not tokens: they stay local to the visualizer by design.

tokens.name: cover-gradient
tokens.usage: Bottom fade over cover art that carries a caption, in both themes (vinyl at 0, 65%, 90%).

icon.note: Icon spec. 24 viewBox with a 20 live area (2px padding), stroke 1.8 with round caps and joins, currentColor. Fill only play, pause, prev, next and more.

tokens.name: icon-inline
tokens.usage: Inline and pill icons.

tokens.name: icon-action
tokens.usage: Row actions and mini-player transport.

tokens.name: icon-nav
tokens.usage: Navigation and player action icons.

tokens.name: icon-play
tokens.usage: The main play key.

tokens.name: icon-stroke
tokens.usage: Stroke width in viewBox units (unitless).

tokens.name: icon-grid
tokens.usage: viewBox size (unitless).

tokens.name: icon-live
tokens.usage: Live drawing area inside the grid (unitless).

control.note: Web control sizing and the day-safe fill pair. Heights share the hit (44px) rhythm: control-sm 28, control 36, hit 44, control-xl 56. fill and on-fill (colour tokens, web only) are the accent for rings, progress arcs and switch tracks that must stay readable on ground by day (accent-strong by day, accent by night); reapply inside a dark container so they re-resolve.

tokens.name: control-sm
tokens.usage: Compact control height: chips, token pills, small icon buttons (still padded to hit where tappable).

tokens.name: control
tokens.usage: Standard control height: buttons, fields, selects, sort control.

tokens.name: control-xl
tokens.usage: Large control height: the lit play key, sign-in buttons.

tokens.name: track-seek
tokens.usage: Seek bar track thickness.

tokens.name: track-volume
tokens.usage: Volume slider track thickness; equals stroke-progress.

tokens.name: thumb-seek
tokens.usage: Seek bar thumb diameter.

tokens.name: thumb-volume
tokens.usage: Volume slider thumb diameter.

tokens.name: drag-scale
tokens.usage: transform: scale() of a slider thumb while dragged; eased over dur-fast.

tokens.name: dialog-width
tokens.usage: Maximum width of a dialog.

tokens.name: dialog-width-wide
tokens.usage: Maximum width of a wide dialog (identify results, share, song edit with tables).

tokens.name: grab-w
tokens.usage: Sheet grab handle width.

tokens.name: grab-h
tokens.usage: Sheet grab handle height; radius is half of it.
